title: Automated System Liability & Critical Incident Enforcement

documents.title: Accelerated Critical Incident Notification
documents.text: Clause INC-301 supersedes the reporting timeline in Clause AI-104. Critical incidents resulting in financial loss or safety harm must now be reported to the national authority within 72 hours, not 14 days.

documents.title: Strict Liability for Autonomous Failures
documents.text: Deployers of autonomous decision agents without certified human oversight (as defined in AI-102) bear strict financial liability for quantifiable damages caused by algorithmic hallucinations or errors.

documents.title: Tamper-Proof Audit Trail Requirement
documents.text: All inference decisions, retrieval contexts, and adapter version hashes must be cryptographically logged into a tamper-evident audit ledger retained for a minimum of 7 years.

documents.title: Automated Circuit Breakers
documents.text: Inference endpoints exceeding a 2% verification failure rate over a rolling 1-hour window must engage automated traffic throttling or graceful failover to human operators.
